description: This PHP class implements a value formatting strategy to convert an entity value into a human-readable activity name, based on a project activity ID, within the context of an HR management system plugin.

classes.name: FormatWithActivity
classes.description: Implements ValueFormatter interface to format entity values into activity names by querying the TimesheetService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ProjectActivity object using the activity ID and returns its name if valid, otherwise null.
